research_notes: The operating cap should be chosen with enough margin that ordinary close variance does not frequently consume the entire reserve.
A max-observed close overhead is conservative but may be noisy; upper-tail plus explicit safety margin may be more stable after enough samples.
Until enough observations exist, err toward a wider reserve rather than false precision.
The current coarse search is not yet the stage to set that number.
Its purpose is locating the viable runtime region.
No reserve value is promoted from this single sample.
